C1.worst_defect: Home never says who should NOT use it or how it compares to Shopify POS / Square / Lightspeed; a client weighing tills gets no 'not for you if' section, and the hero spreads weight across four equal CTAs

C2.worst_defect: Home comparison table says the live demo sends nothing: "the demo store lives in your browser, and nothing leaves the page", while Connect a till says the demo "posts anonymous demo events to ph.wcpos.com"; footer says "MIT licensed" but self-building "needs your own RxDB Premium licence token in RXDB_PREMIUM", which home and Limitations omit

C3.worst_defect: Quick start's "Missing / old plugin" check still names "order.create v4 and register v1" though 0.3.0 ships order.create v5, and the demo shows refunds that a real store cannot get ("Refunds at the till need the plugin release after 0.3.0")

C4.worst_defect: Changelog reads as internal notes ("ADR 0005", "order.create v5") with "Tally UI" vs "TallyUI" spelled two ways; troubleshooting repeats the stale "order.create v4"; two app hosts (app.vendurepos.com, vendurepos.vercel.app) with no word on who runs them

C5.worst_defect: On docs desktop slices the grey sidebar panel stops around y≈900 and the column below is bare white, so pages look unfinished; og-image logo is a hollow empty circle

C6.worst_defect: Home comparison table is squeezed into three narrow columns at 390 px, cell text stacks a word or two per line and is hard to scan; quick-start phone capture is clipped at "Optional: a device key for"

C7.worst_defect: 404 page reuses the home meta description and logs "Failed to load resource: 404" with no search box to recover; og-image is generic

overall_worst.defect: Privacy claim contradicted: home table says of the demo "nothing leaves the page" while Connect a till says it "posts anonymous demo events to ph.wcpos.com"; together with "MIT licensed" hiding the RxDB Premium licence needed to self-build, a sceptic stops trusting the honesty claims
overall_worst.fix: Change the home cell to "No: the demo store lives in your browser; only anonymous usage events go to ph.wcpos.com", and add a Limitations bullet plus a footer note that building the till yourself needs a paid RxDB Premium licence
